title: DadJoke Achievements
description: This mod introduces DadJokes as Achievements for commonly occuring Minecraft actions.
body:
📣 Unleash the Groans: The Ultimate Dad Jokes Mod! 🧔🌾
Are your technical builds running a little too smoothly? Is your massive automated base missing that special touch of absolute cringe? It’s time to fix that. The Dad Jokes Mod is here to deliver a perfectly timed collection of pun-believable humor directly to your game chat and achievement pop-ups! 🧱✨

No random numbers, no escape. Every single joke is hard-coded to trigger the exact millisecond someone tries to play the game normally. Whether you're deep-slate mining or crafting basic tools, you'll never have to suffer through a quiet, peaceful milestone again.

✨ Key Features
🏆 16 Precision Achievements: Turn standard Minecraft milestones into psychological warfare. The exact millisecond a player punches their first log or crafts a sword, a custom advancement notification flashes on screen to damage their soul.

🏷️ Comedy Gold Tooltips: Hover over any of the 16 custom icons inside the Advancement menu to discover the full, completely unnecessary dad-joke flavor text and punchlines!

💬 Action-Triggered Chat Puns: No random RNG here! These jokes are precision-engineered to broadcast to the global server chat the exact moment players perform specific survival tasks. Everyone suffers together!

📖 The Comedy Book: Craft the ultimate guide in-game to unleash curated wit whenever your friends (or siblings) least expect it.

🛋️ Why download this mod?
Your world has plenty of diamonds, iron, and redstone, but it is drastically low on pure irony. This mod is the perfect addition for solo play to keep yourself entertained, or for putting the patience of your server mates to the absolute test. ⚔️

⚠️ Note: This is a coordinated strike! Make sure both you and your target subjects have the mod installed so the triggers sync up and the entire server can experience the puns together.

Download today and start building your automated cringe empire! 🚀🔥

Disclaimers: This mod is only in alpha for now so there is 1 bug at the moment to get the furnace achievment you need to place the furnace and the wood advancment doesnt work yet. 

New Advancments:
Wood You Believe It?
Standard Furnace-ture
Oar-Struck
A Real Gem
and 12 more!
